resetModal.title: Reset Agent
resetModal.intro: Choose what to reset. Anything left unchecked is kept. Settings and credentials are never affected.

sessions.label: Chats
sessions.description: Delete extra chats, clear Main, and clear Living UI chat history. Apps are kept.

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: AGENT / MEMORY / PROACTIVE notes and the memory index.

triggers.label: Triggers & scheduled tasks
triggers.description: Automations, schedules, and the activity log.

workspace.label: Workspace files
workspace.description: Files the agent created in its workspace.

livingui.label: LivingUI apps
livingui.description: Deletes every app the agent has built. A final backup of each app's data is saved and kept.

importProfileModal.needsEnv: After import, fill in API keys for: <1>{{names}}</1>
importProfileModal.mergeReplaceHint: Adds new skills, MCPs, and apps. Overwrites personality files and MCP/skill config on name conflict. Living UI apps with matching names are imported alongside (never destroyed).
importProfileModal.overwriteHint: <0>Destructive.</0> Wipes <1>all</1> existing skills, MCP servers, and Living UI apps, then installs only what's in this bundle. Your agent becomes a copy of the bundle. Cannot be undone.

playbookModal.title: Playbooks
playbookModal.worksBestWithHint: These are hints — CraftBot can run the prompt without them, and will offer to help install anything missing.

skillCreatorModal.successIntro: The agent is working on it now. You'll see progress in chat and the new task will appear in the task panel. Feel free to close this dialog.
skillCreatorModal.title: Create skill from task
skillCreatorModal.intro: CraftBot will read this task's record and turn it into a reusable skill. The new (or edited) skill will be invocable on future tasks.
skillCreatorModal.createHint: Distil this task into a brand-new skill.
skillCreatorModal.improveHint: Refine the existing skill using this task as evidence.
skillCreatorModal.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Example: <1>weekly-pr-summary</1>.
skillCreatorModal.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Must start with a letter, 2–64 chars.
skillCreatorModal.nameReserved: This name is reserved. Pick another.
skillCreatorModal.submitting: Submitting — waiting for the agent to acknowledge…
